name: Devourer of Souls
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A succubus is a devourer of souls, destroyer of hearts, tempter of men. A creature of profound evil and of singular mind.

It cannot be brought into our world without a stimulus.

Thus we use its own strength against it. With the hearts of good men, pure men, loving men, the succubus will be unable to resist, and will cross into our world. Then you can dominate it, and make it your own.

Speak with my assistant, Godrick Farsan, within the Temple. He will help you find your bait.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Godrick Farsan in the Temple of the Damned.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You were sent by Carendin? adventurer, then.

Do not think light of me because my sight is gone. I see things that lie behind now, with clarity I had never known. What I once thought a curse, is now a boon.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 20, 3,260 XP in all.

quests.name: Devourer of Souls
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Godrick Farsan in the Temple of the Damned.

quests.name: Hearts of the Pure
quests.objectiveText: Bring the hearts of Dalin Forgewright and Corma Villard to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.

quests.name: The Binding
quests.objectiveText: Using the Pure Hearts, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Pure Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
